params.name: detailed
params.description: Include extra information required to sort and categorise filters in the Prolific app. This is not required for API use. Default false.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: The workspace ID for the workspace you are creating a study or filterset in. This is used to get contextual data such as previous studies and participant groups.

params.name: filter_tag
params.description: Can be used to return only Custom Group filters.

items.docs: List all filters that can be applied to your filter sets or studies.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the filter to get distribution for. Only filters tagged with "custom-group" are supported.

params.name: distribution_filters
params.description: Filters to get distributions for. This should be a comma-separated list of filter IDs. Only filters tagged with "allow-distribution" are supported.

items.docs: Get the distribution of a filter.

Count how many participants meet all the given filters.
Only participants that pass **every one** of the filters are counted.
Zero means that there are less than 25 participants. We do not show lower numbers to protect the privacy of the participants.

To see a list of filters that may be passed to this endpoint, see the documentation for filters.
